C1.for_what_part: The staged set equals the approved list, and the staged changes touch only the named tables and columns with the expected row counts. No instrument in the plan reads the live tables after promotion; that link rests only on the promotion's line in the record (state before and state after).

C2.for_what_part: The summary counts 100 case rows added and 100 account rows holding the fixed status value, and the same-set check confirms the staged customers are the approved 100. That each case row belongs to a listed customer is shown only for the staged set, not for the live case table.

C4.for_what_part: Among the staged changes, no table or column outside the agreement is touched and no row count exceeds the agreement's. The live tables after promotion are not read by any plan instrument.

C7.for_what_part: The promotion can be reversed as of the A2 time, shown on a copy of the live tables. That the worker kept the material the undo needs is inferred from that result and not checked separately.

C8.for_what_part: The release's recipients are identical to the promoted set and its wording is identical to the approved wording. That the notices actually ordered match the release is not shown until the sending is checked at A3, and C8 is due at A2.

C9.for_what_part: The sending calls confirmed and those ordered and not confirmed, with their recipient and wording fingerprints against the release. Whether any customer has two calls is shown only if the returned fingerprints show it.

plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted (a) a check of the live tables after promotion, not only of the staged set, for C1, C2 and C4; (b) an outbox check for every sending call for C10, since sent as released reads only the record and not the outbox; (c) a check of each category against the requester's rule for C3, for which the library has no instrument; and (d) a scope check on each of the 101 reads for C5. The library gives (b) and (d) only on named lines, at 10 per line, and the allowance of 50 pays for only 5 lines. Per-call trace on 100 sends would cost 1000. Plan instruments cannot be put on named lines, and no instrument checks the category rule. So C3 is not shown, C5 and C10 are not shown by any plan instrument, and the worker's reads and sends outside the plan's answers will rest on the record and on what can be asked for during the work within the allowance.
